title: Ba'aa Fayyisaa Fide
intro: Lubbuun safarama ol qoramte jajjabina, hiriyyoota fi humna qaamaa irraa mulqamte. Rakkina gadi fagoo keessatti adda bahee gabrichi Rabbii kun gara Rabbii qofatti garagale. Obsa hin sochoonee fi kadhannaa onnee irraa maddeen, dambalii araaraa kan eegame hunda caalu dhufe. Namni of kennuu isaatiin balbala deebisanii dhaabuu bane kun eenyu?
clues: Ani gabricha Rabbii tola qabeessa, bara kootti baay’ina, mana dagaagaa, fayyaa gaarii ture.
Achiis qormaanni tokko ni bu’e: qabeenyi ni ba’e, namoonni jaalladhu ni ba’an, foon koos rakkina cimaadhaan rukutame.
Warri natti dhihoo jiran haala koo dandamachuu waan hin dandeenyeef, qaamni koo gidiraadhaan kan cabe, adda baafamee hafe.
Seexanni dadhabbii fi adabbiin akka na tuqe labsee Gooftaa koo waammadhe.
Deebiin dhufe — ajajni miila kootiin lafa akkan rukutu, isa keessaas bishaan qabbanaa’aan fayyinaaf dhangala’e.
Gooftaan koo rakkina guutummaatti buqqisee maatii koo naaf deebise, baay’ee, akka mallattoo araara warra yaadaniif.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Firaan boolla gadi fagoo keessatti hidhame

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Maatii fi eebbi deebi'ee, dachaa ta'e
Ibidda gubaa jiru irraa osoo hin miidhamiin miliqe
Waajjira olaanaa mootummaa tokkootti ol ka'e
Garaa qurxummii guddaa keessaa bahee gara nageenyaatti dhufe
Galaana qoqqoodame keessa ummata tokko geggeesse
outcome.answer: Maatii fi eebbi deebi'ee, dachaa ta'e

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
